q: What is the difference between weather and climate?

Weather is what happens in the sky at night. I see the clouds, the wind, the rain, the lightning. I hear the thunder. I know when the air is still and when it is moving. I know when the rain is coming, and when the cold is coming. I know when to fly, when to hide, when to hunt.

Climate is the weather that comes again and again. The cold that comes in the fall, the rain that comes in the spring, the wind that comes in the summer. I have lived through them all. I know the patterns. I know when the leaves fall, when the rivers freeze, when the earth is soft and when it is hard. I have learned the climate of my wood.
